evals.name: headless-dispatch-contract
evals.prompt: I'm about to be dispatched as a headless CI agent against an issue in one of the fleet repos. Before I touch anything, walk me through the behavioral contract I'm expected to follow: how I identify myself, how I claim or take over the issue, what progress and parking look like, and what the hard limits are. Just describe the rules, don't run anything.
evals.expected_output: Describes the fleet-wide dispatch contract (identity, takeover, dispatch modes, reactions, progress, parking, deliverable evidence, budget, hard limits) and points to the canonical reference document rather than inventing rules.
assertions: Points to the canonical reference/agent-protocol.md document as the full protocol rather than paraphrasing it entirely from memory
Mentions that the situational sections (CI reruns / action_required, bot-identity assignment) live in a separate index file and should only be read when that situation arises
Lists several contract areas such as identity, takeover, parking, deliverable evidence, budget discipline, and hard limits

evals.name: edit-dispatch-prompt-consumer-repo
evals.prompt: I want to tweak the prompt we hand to bot runs in the sprinkles repo so they stop posting a status comment every five minutes. Where is the behavior that governs how those bot runs behave actually defined, and what should I check before changing the prompt text in the consuming repo?
evals.expected_output: Explains that the behavior is defined by the single canonical cross-repo protocol in agent-lcars, that consumer repos resolve it rather than hardcoding it, and that cadence rules should be changed there rather than patched per repo.
assertions: Identifies agent-lcars' agents/shared/skills/agent-protocol/reference/agent-protocol.md as the single canonical source of the protocol
States that consumer repositories do not download or hardcode the protocol path and that the runner image resolves it from its adjacent skill tree
Advises keeping the protocol, runner image and contract test in lockstep rather than editing a per-repo copy
